entities.title: afs source
entities.summary: Every Rust module of the afs binary, flat in one folder: the command line, the MCP server, the request engine, the six operations, the session state and the file loaders.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole tool. main.rs parses the command line and runs one of three front ends (call, jsonl, serve); engine.rs turns a JSON request into one of six operations (read, search, list, stat, outline, diff_since); state.rs keeps what one session has already sent, the file versions it can diff against and its cached results; fsio.rs, uring.rs and aio.rs load files; walk.rs and par.rs walk directories and spread work over the cores.
boundaries: Only reads: no operation writes, renames or deletes a file.
A session lives in one process's memory and ends with it; nothing is written to disk.
uring.rs is compiled only on Linux and aio.rs only on macOS (the #[cfg(target_os)] attributes on their mod lines in main.rs).
